vulnerability.name: CVE-2020-36518
vulnerability.description: jackson-databind allows a Java StackOverflow exception and denial of service via a large depth of nested objects.

statements.impact_statement: The Jackson ObjectMapper is configured with StreamReadConstraints maxNestingDepth=100 for every externally reachable endpoint.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2020-8203
vulnerability.description: Prototype pollution in lodash via zipObjectDeep.

statements.impact_statement: lodash is bundled only for the admin UI, which does not call zipObjectDeep or any other deep-merge helper reachable from user input.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2021-44228
vulnerability.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

statements.impact_statement: Message lookups are disabled in the shipped log4j2.xml and the container starts with -Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true. No user-controlled value reaches a logged message pattern.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-44487
vulnerability.description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-45857
vulnerability.description: axios inserts the X-XSRF-TOKEN header using the secret XSRF-TOKEN cookie value in all requests to any host.

statements.action_statement: Upgrade axios to 1.6.7 in release 4.7.0, planned for 2026-08-15. Until then the admin UI is served from the same origin as the API and no third-party host receives the XSRF cookie.
